coverageModel.assumption: Uniform orthographic ground rectangles. Screen north dimension is compressed by cos(pitch). Actual Google perspective footprint and resulting AI images are NOT registered to these rectangles.

productionLimits.warning: 24 frames cover the polygon in a planning model; native 1672×941 output is still approximately1.675m/pixel east-west, unsuitable for facade/window detail or a 409% enlargement claim. Source photographs at north-up39.44°must be captured and verified before image generation.
